title: Complete deterministic physics rule-list model (in-domain LOCO)
determinism: no learned weights; thresholds = fixed training-clip quantiles p01/p05/p10/p25 quantised to 4 dp; integer score = count of crossed thresholds; reject point from 5% training-good FR budget

headline.note: headline BA counts REVIEW in the denominator: 0.710 (review-as-accept) / 0.590 (review-as-reject) at 40% coverage; 0.808 is decided-only and must not be the headline

leakage.candidate_rule_list_and_signs: the candidate rule list, the feature choice and the directions were chosen by the author with all 150 gold labels visible; the LOCO thresholds are nested, but this selection is not, so 0.8224 is an OPTIMISTIC in-domain estimate
leakage.sign_evidence_is_all_windows: the flow_act/flow_med direction cites an all-window median (0.59 bad vs 0.27 good), not a training-fold sign
leakage.nested_alternative: a fully nested per-fold feature+sign selection (loco_selected, top-12) gives 0.7618
leakage.operating_point: both operating points are chosen on the same 150 windows; the fr5 point is chosen with a pre-registered 5% training-good false-reject budget

baselines_same_folds.like_for_like_note: the rule list uses 26 full + 16 physics features; logistic_26feat is NOT like-for-like, logistic_42feat is

paired_clip_bootstrap_auroc_difference.note: paired clip-grouped bootstrap (2,000 shared resamples, seed 0); delta is AUROC(rules) - AUROC(baseline), both oriented higher=bad

ablations.note: selecting features per fold overfits clip-specific features; the fixed spec candidate list is what transfers

per_window_scores_note: one row per gold window; every reported metric (LOCO AUROC, CIs, paired deltas, BA) is derivable from these rows + the clip field
